Kangana Ranaut vs Naseeruddin Shah

Kangana Ranaut and Piyush Mishra criticized Naseeruddin Shah for his silence on the Jharkhand protests. Naseeruddin Shah had earlier questioned the silence of many A-list celebrities over the student protests. An Agra lawyer filed a case against Kangana Ranaut for her 'generation gutter' remark on NEET protesters. The controversy began when Naseeruddin Shah made a remark about the protests. Kangana Ranaut responded with a jab at Naseeruddin Shah. The exchange has sparked a debate about celebrity involvement in social issues.
